scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @flowdraft/api
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @flowdraft/extension
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:extension
scripts.zip: npm run build:contracts && npm run zip -w @flowdraft/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @flowdraft/extension && npm run typecheck -w @flowdraft/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flowdraft/extension && npm run test -w @flowdraft/api
